summary: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, announcing an agreement with an affiliate of Royal Gold, Inc. to settle a fixed gold delivery obligation. The settlement involves delivering 5,000 ounces of gold and 2,652,532 common shares at a deemed price of US$5.86 per share, funded by unwinding gold price protection instruments (~$7 million) and cash. This is a liability settlement, not a merger or acquisition. The transaction removes over $40 million in future debt obligations and requires TSX approval. It is a routine debt restructuring, not a special situation.
